newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index increased 43.7 points or 1.50 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index fell 0.84 percent.
Oct 25 Oct 181 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The Eyres Reed Explorer Index moved 43.7 points higher as interest and activity increased in the speculative resource sector, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
Positive reports and quarterly exploration resutls drove interest and gains outnumbered falls four to three.

Sipa Resources International NL and Arcadia Minerals Ltd, recent Ashburton gold discovery partners, continued their strong performances, Sipa up five cents to 50 cents and Arcadia up 15 cents to 70 cents.

Titan Resources Ltd benefited from the Australian Nickel conference earlier in the week, bringing focus to their current drilling at the Goodyear nickel discovery near Kambalda, Western Australia. The shares traded six cents higher at 42.5 cents.

Golden Valley Mines NL its recent rise, after negotiating an effective 9.5 percent interest in the Busang Central Zone gold deposit in Indonesia, lifting 1.8 cents to 6.9 cents, and Venture Exploration NL improved after a boardroom shuffle up 3.5 cents to 36 cents.

Bounces off recent lows were recorded by Denehurst Ltd, up 4.5 cents to 15 cents and Golden Tiger, up 10 cents to 75 cents. Other strong performances included Noble Resources, up 1.5 cents to nine cents, Kurnalpi Gold NL, up three cents to 23 cents, and AFrican explorer Tanganyika Gold NL finished the week three cents higher at 27.5 cents.
